# sg-docs

## Mission

`sg-docs` is the public owner for internal architecture, governance, context, metadata, and agent documentation.

## Scope Gate

Use this for internal documentation. Resolve the product and internal documentation surface, load `$SHIPGLOWS_ROOT/skills/references/intent-to-outcome-autonomy.md`, and keep public docs and audience content with `sg-content`.

## Required References

Resolve `$SHIPGLOWS_ROOT` through the shared canonical-path doctrine, verify the root and `$SHIPGLOWS_ROOT/skills/300-sg-docs/SKILL.md` exist, then load that canonical engine for documentation governance and validation. If the root or file is missing, stop with a visible error; never fall back to a sibling runtime path. Treat `300-sg-docs` as expert/legacy only.

## Validation

Use the selected governance workflow's structure, metadata, and repository-consistency checks.

## Stop Conditions

Stop and follow the runtime contract when the documentation boundary, ownership, source of truth, or required validation is unresolved.

## Report Modes

Load `$SHIPGLOWS_ROOT/skills/references/reporting-contract.md` before reporting; keep internal engine names out of user-facing reports.

</instruction>
